name: modern-action-missing-ref
description: A modern tools/call for an action tool (click) that names an app but omits snapshot_ref is rejected before any side effect. The result is a decorated modern isError tool result whose structuredContent.error reports snapshot_ref_missing with retry new_state. The error precedes all platform code, so the bytes are identical on Linux, Windows, and macOS.

content.text: Missing required argument: snapshot_ref. Call get_app_state and pass the returned snapshot_ref.

error.message: Missing required argument: snapshot_ref. Call get_app_state and pass the returned snapshot_ref.
